clues: This city sits in Portugal, far from the sea. It is known as the past capital of the Alentejo.
This city is one of the hottest in Portugal in the summer. Heat waves strike it often.
Its old town became a World Heritage Site in 1986. Old walls and monuments from many ages still stand there.
Each year, a survey asks how good life is in each city. This city comes in second in Portugal.
Look for a Roman temple still standing now in the heart of its old town.
